title: tc-radar-chart
description:
Values on three or more axes round a centre, joined into a shape – one series with its values on the axes, or up to
three compared – as a cross of axes or a web of rings, with a table view.

heading.description: The heading, and the drawing's name

axes.description: The axes' names, clockwise from the top

series.description: The series to draw – the first three; each has a value per axis

max.description: The value at the edge; by default the largest value (100 when the unit is "%")

grid.description: Bare axes from the centre ("axes"), or rings at each quarter as well ("web")

hideValues.description: Leaves the values off the axes' names, for one series

axisHeader.description: The table's corner: what the axes are

view.description: The chart or the same numbers as a table. Changed by the Table button unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

name.description: Its name, in the legend and the table

values.description: One value per axis, in the axes' order; null (or missing) is no data
